# Maintainer notes

- Residents may contribute from forks or hold write access as outside
  collaborators; company maintainers are in
  `@PrimeIntellect-ai/residency-maintainers`.
- `main` requires a PR, one company CODEOWNER approval, Ruff, and unit tests.
  There are no bypass actors.
- Secretless checks run on every PR update. Bugbot and Macroscope run
  automatically. CI does not run model evaluations.
- Contributors with write access can push to any non-`main` branch; branch names
  are not an authorization boundary.
